title: Comment regrowth guard (batch 0b): a lane's added comments are caught at build exit, not by the auditor
summary: Cycle 1730 (wave 22, sizeratchet-shrink-opscmd) was a correct refactor: every function under 50 lines and the full ACS suite green (172/0). Its audit still FAILed on the item's acceptance criterion 'No comments are added'. `commentaudit comments -base ad816b70 internal/cli/opscmd` exits 1 with 54 added lines, mostly doc comments on new unexported helpers that restate the name. No ACS predicate or gate checks the criterion, so it cost an audit round and a build retry that a deterministic check would have prevented. docs/plans/comment-reduction-2026-09.md 'Guard against regrowth' already designs batch 0b: run the check at build exit so a correction returns to build before audit, keep ship as the backstop, and roll out shadow then enforce. Count added comments across the whole diff so decomposition moves are not flagged, and fix the design inputs listed there (trailing comments, raw-string lines). This item carries that design into code.
acceptance: A build whose diff adds whole-line comments (commentaudit comments semantics) gets a correction back to build before audit, naming each added line; in shadow it emits a WARN signal instead
A moved comment and a new file's package doc are not counted, as commentaudit comments already rules
The stage is config (shadow then enforce), never a flag; tests pin both stages
The plan's batch 0b row and code-comments.md Enforcement name the gate
priority_rationale: A logic-correct lane FAILed its first audit on a mechanical rule; the streak goal pays for every such round
consumed_by: console landing feat/comment-floor-shadow (2026-09-28): SHIPPED IN SHADOW. commentFloorFailures in the build handoff floor counts the comment lines a build adds across the whole diff (commentaudit.AddedAcrossDiff; moves and renames spared), stage from policy.json comment_floor.stage (shadow default, enforce, off). Acceptance 1-4 met (shadow WARN, enforce rejection naming each line, moved comment and new package doc not counted, stage is config with both stages pinned, plan and code-comments.md updated). Enforce follows the measurement: comment-floor-enforce.
